Bihar's Makhana Exported to Greece with APEDA Support

A one-tonne consignment of makhana (fox nuts) from Bihar has been exported to Greece, with support from the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA). The export signifies an expansion of Bihar's makhana into the global market.
